datasets.name: Landslide inventory map of the Nova Friburgo mountains
datasets.verbatim: The landslide inventory map of the study area was manually generated by experts from high-resolution satellite images based on shape and tone information, and validated using Google Earth Pro and compared with landslide maps produced by other scholars [44].

datasets.name: RapidEye high-resolution image
datasets.verbatim: The high-resolution image used in this article was acquired by the RapidEye sensor on August 13, 2011.

methods.name: Feature-based constraint deep U-Net (FCDU-Net)
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation method that integrates spectral bands with auxiliary features (NDVI and GLCM texture features). It uses the Relief-F algorithm to select optimal features and a Deep U-Net (DU-Net) architecture for end-to-end landslide detection.
methods.source: Guosen Xu, Yi Wang, Lizhe Wang, Lucas Pedrosa Soares, and Carlos H. Grohmann
methods.verbatim: In this article, we propose an effective FCDU-Net semantic segmentation method.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input imagery are mentioned without links or public availability, and the custom FCDU-Net code is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
